it.title: Senet
it.description: Una versione elettronica online del Senet, antenato del Backgammon e simile al Gioco Reale di Ur, con due set di regole (CEMEA e Kendall & Bell)

en.title: Senet
en.description: An online version of Senet, an ancestor of Backgammon and similar to the Royal Game of Ur, with two rule sets (CEMEA and Kendall & Bell).

it.title: Wari
it.description: Una versione elettronica online del Wari, il più diffuso dei mancala, con due set di regole (Abapa e Caraibi), tre livelli di gioco e strategia avanzata

en.title: Wari
en.description: An online version of Wari, the most widespread mancala game, with two rule sets (Abapa and Caribbean), three difficulty levels, and advanced strategy.

en.title: Royal Game of Ur
en.description: An online electronic version of the Royal Game of Ur, an ancestor of Backgammon, featuring two rule sets (Finkel and Bell).
An online electronic version of Tablut, with Linnean rules (retranslated)
